title: Practice 4: Numerals, nouns and adjectives together

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: The film lasted 2 hours.
exercises.why: **два часа** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (час → часа).

exercises.q: Ты обещал, что в деревне будет много ___ (ёжики)!
exercises.prompt: You promised that there would be plenty of hedgehogs in the village!
exercises.why: **много ёжиков** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (ёжик → ёжиков).

exercises.prompt: Much gold is mined here.
exercises.why: **много золота** — много with something you cannot count takes the genitive singular (золото → золота).

exercises.prompt: Rome has a lot of ancient buildings.
exercises.why: **много древних** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (древний → древних).

exercises.prompt: The seven muses aided the artists.
exercises.why: **семь муз** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (муза → муз).

exercises.q: Два ___ (медведь) в одной берлоге не живут.
exercises.prompt: Two bears cannot live in the same den.
exercises.why: **два медведя** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (медведь → медведя).

exercises.q: Сегодня я купил много ___ (книги) и теперь расставляю их.
exercises.prompt: I bought many books today so I put them in order.
exercises.why: **много книг** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (книга → книг).

exercises.prompt: There are many beds in the house.
exercises.why: **много комнат** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (комната → комнат).

exercises.q: Моему соседу ампутировали обе ___ (ступня) из-за бактериальной инфекции.
exercises.prompt: My neighbor had his feet amputated due to a bacterial infection.
exercises.why: **ступня → ступни** (gen. sg.: after обе). Declines like неделя. Ending -я → -и.

exercises.prompt: Insects have six legs.
exercises.why: **шесть ног** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (нога → ног).

exercises.prompt: Tom smoked two packets of cigarettes yesterday.
exercises.why: **две пачки** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (пачка → пачки).

exercises.q: Есть три ___ (вид) лжи: ложь, наглая ложь и статистика.
exercises.prompt: There are three kinds of lies: lies, damned lies, and statistics.
exercises.why: **три вида** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (вид → вида).

exercises.prompt: Tom told us a whole pack of lies.
exercises.why: **три короба** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (короб → короба).

exercises.prompt: I want five meatballs.
exercises.why: **пять фрикаделек** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (фрикаделька → фрикаделек).

exercises.prompt: How much horsepower does a horse have?
exercises.why: **сколько лошадиных сил** — сколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (лошадиный сила → лошадиных сил).

exercises.q: Сколько ___ (яйца) в неделю сносит эта курица?
exercises.prompt: How many eggs does this hen lay each week?
exercises.why: **сколько яиц** — сколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (яйцо → яиц).

exercises.q: Могу ли я заказать звонок-будильник на семь ___ (утро)?
exercises.prompt: Could you give me a wake-up call at seven?
exercises.why: **семь утра** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (утро → утра).

exercises.prompt: Forty percent of food in the United States is wasted.
exercises.why: **сорок процентов** — round tens and hundreds (30, 50, 100, 800…) take the genitive plural (процент → процентов).

exercises.prompt: I caught three fish yesterday.
exercises.why: **три рыбины** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (рыбина → рыбины).

exercises.prompt: We have a lot of competitors.
exercises.why: **много конкурентов** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (конкурент → конкурентов).
